en.title: The Lighthouse That Chronicles Eight Million Moments, Unforgotten
en.premise: When the pact with the god who governs the seasons is broken, one island is trapped in eternal winter while another is frozen in perpetual spring. A young binding master obtains a broken pocket watch, an artifact from another world, and sets out to reclaim lost time. Upon reaching the ancient lighthouse at the edge of the world, he discovers a cruel yet beautiful truth that the gods have kept hidden.

zh.title: 永不被遗忘的灯塔：记录八百万刻
zh.premise: 当掌管季节的神的约定被打破，一座岛屿陷入永恒的冬季，另一座岛屿则停滞在永恒的春天。年轻的结缘师获得了一枚来自异界的破碎怀表，踏上了夺回失去时间的旅程。当他抵达世界尽头的古老灯塔时，发现了众神一直隐藏的残酷而美丽的真相。
